dishes.name: Pottery kebab
dishes.desc: Meat and vegetables slow-cooked in a sealed clay pot from Avanos, which is cracked open at the table. It has a geographical indication and is the dish of Cappadocia.

dishes.name: Nevşehir mantı
dishes.desc: Baked rolls of bread dough with spiced mince and onion, sliced and served with garlic yogurt, spicy butter, sumac and mint. Quicker to make than Kayseri's mantı.

dishes.name: Dried kaymak
dishes.desc: Clotted cream made by simmering milk over wood for hours and drying the skin that forms. Eaten with honey or jam, and a specialty of Kaymaklı.

dishes.name: Apricot stew
dishes.desc: Meat and sweet apricots stewed in an earthen pot over a wood fire, with grape molasses if the fruit is not sweet enough. A regional dish of the Cappadocian table.

dishes.name: Zerdeli pilav
dishes.desc: Rice layered with grape molasses, chickpeas, peeled almonds and raisins. A sweet-savoury festive dish of Nevşehir kitchens.
